Corollary
[Higher derivative interior estimate]1. ch16:16.7\group chapter-16↗ gilbarg-trudinger.thm.16.5.interior-gradient-bound Let $u\in C^2(\Omega )$ and suppose its graph has mean curvature $H\in C^k(\Omega )$ for $k\geq 1$. Then $u\in C^{k+1}(\Omega )$, and for $y\in \Omega $ and $|\beta |=k+1$,

\begin{equation} |D^\beta u(y)|\le C. \tag {16.57} \end{equation}

where $C=C(n,k,|H|_{k,\Omega },d,\sup _\Omega |u|)$ and $d=\dist (y,\partial \Omega )$.
